scope: Actual Earth-scale CPU terrain, one L14 parent and four L15 children, production surface map/material/Forward+ depth-normal pass. Fixed camera checks morph endpoints, tiny morph steps, stable hold, reversal and depth. Full continuous player descent video remains a separate acceptance.

checks.name: Fixture renders nonempty finite real terrain
Child t0 reproduces parent surface and material
Tiny morph step is continuous rather than full-detail replacement
Full child endpoint retains additional visible geometry and shading
Stopped representation gives identical repeated GPU frames
Reversing morph returns the identical representation
Depth-normal prepass uses identical parent endpoint
Depth texture follows geometric morph instead of fixed child shape
